notes: hace siglos = for ages, a very long time.

sentences.text: Esta iglesia tiene cinco siglos.
sentences.translation: This church is five centuries old.

sentences.text: La casa es del siglo pasado.
sentences.translation: The house is from the last century.

sentences.text: ¡Llevo siglos esperando!
sentences.translation: I've been waiting for ages!

notes: estar molesto = to be annoyed; ser molesto = to be annoying.

sentences.text: Está molesto conmigo.
sentences.translation: He's annoyed with me.

sentences.text: Es un ruido muy molesto.
sentences.translation: It's a really annoying noise.

sentences.text: Los vecinos estaban molestos por la fiesta.
sentences.translation: The neighbors were annoyed about the party.

notes: cortarse el pelo = to get a haircut.

sentences.text: ¿Me cortas un trozo de pan?
sentences.translation: Can you cut me a piece of bread?

sentences.text: Me corté el pelo ayer.
sentences.translation: I got my hair cut yesterday.

sentences.text: Se ha cortado con un cuchillo.
sentences.translation: He has cut himself with a knife.

sentences.text: Nos cortaron la luz.
sentences.translation: They cut off our electricity.

notes: por fortuna = luckily; probar fortuna = to try your luck.

sentences.text: Ese coche cuesta una fortuna.
sentences.translation: That car costs a fortune.

sentences.text: Por fortuna, nadie se hizo daño.
sentences.translation: Luckily, nobody got hurt.

sentences.text: Quiero probar fortuna en otra ciudad.
sentences.translation: I want to try my luck in another city.

sentences.text: Te envío el archivo por correo.
sentences.translation: I'll send you the file by email.

sentences.text: No puedo abrir este archivo.
sentences.translation: I can't open this file.

sentences.text: Tengo los archivos en el ordenador.
sentences.translation: I have the files on the computer.

notes: en presencia de = in front of, with someone there.

sentences.text: Firmó el contrato en presencia de su abogado.
sentences.translation: He signed the contract in the presence of his lawyer.

sentences.text: Nadie se dio cuenta de su presencia.
sentences.translation: Nobody noticed she was there.

sentences.text: Tiene mucha presencia en el escenario.
sentences.translation: He has a lot of stage presence.

sentences.text: Cada día con los niños es una aventura.
sentences.translation: Every day with the kids is an adventure.

sentences.text: Me encantan las películas de aventuras.
sentences.translation: I love adventure movies.

sentences.text: Tuvo una aventura con su jefe.
sentences.translation: She had an affair with her boss.

notes: estar de gira = to be on tour.

sentences.text: La banda está de gira.
sentences.translation: The band is on tour.

sentences.text: La gira empieza en marzo.
sentences.translation: The tour starts in March.

sentences.text: Hicieron dos giras por Europa.
sentences.translation: They did two tours of Europe.

sentences.text: Mi hermana trabaja en servicios sociales.
sentences.translation: My sister works in social services.

sentences.text: Paso demasiado tiempo en las redes sociales.
sentences.translation: I spend too much time on social media.

sentences.text: Tiene una vida social muy activa.
sentences.translation: She has a very active social life.

notes: la comunidad de vecinos = all the residents of a building.

sentences.text: Vivimos en una comunidad muy unida.
sentences.translation: We live in a very close community.

sentences.text: La comunidad de vecinos se reúne hoy.
sentences.translation: The building's residents are meeting today.

sentences.text: En las comunidades del norte llueve mucho.
sentences.translation: It rains a lot in the northern regions.

notes: empezar de cero = to start from scratch.

sentences.text: Un millón tiene seis ceros.
sentences.translation: A million has six zeros.

sentences.text: Ganamos tres a cero.
sentences.translation: We won three to nothing.

sentences.text: Tuvimos que empezar de cero.
sentences.translation: We had to start from scratch.

notes: convertirse en = to become. The e changes: convierte, convirtió.

sentences.text: El frío convierte el agua en hielo.
sentences.translation: Cold turns water into ice.

sentences.text: Se convirtió en un actor famoso.
sentences.translation: He became a famous actor.

sentences.text: Han convertido la vieja fábrica en un museo.
sentences.translation: They've turned the old factory into a museum.

sentences.text: Le falta una pieza a la máquina.
sentences.translation: The machine is missing a part.

sentences.text: El juego tiene cien piezas.
sentences.translation: The game has a hundred pieces.

sentences.text: Tocó una pieza muy bonita al piano.
sentences.translation: She played a very beautiful piece on the piano.

sentences.text: Tengo dolor de estómago desde ayer.
sentences.translation: I've had a stomachache since yesterday.

sentences.text: No tomes café con el estómago vacío.
sentences.translation: Don't drink coffee on an empty stomach.

sentences.text: No comas tanto, que te va a doler el estómago.
sentences.translation: Don't eat so much, or your stomach will hurt.

sentences.text: ¿Es legal hacer eso?
sentences.translation: Is it legal to do that?

sentences.text: Tienen problemas legales con la empresa.
sentences.translation: They have legal problems with the company.

sentences.text: Hay que leer la parte legal del contrato.
sentences.translation: You have to read the legal part of the contract.

notes: el Reino Unido = the United Kingdom.

sentences.text: Había una vez un reino muy lejano.
sentences.translation: Once upon a time there was a faraway kingdom.

sentences.text: Mi prima vive en el Reino Unido.
sentences.translation: My cousin lives in the United Kingdom.

sentences.text: Los dos reinos estaban en guerra.
sentences.translation: The two kingdoms were at war.

sentences.text: ¡Qué alegría verte!
sentences.translation: It's so good to see you!

sentences.text: Estaba loca de alegría.
sentences.translation: She was wild with joy.

sentences.text: La vida tiene alegrías y penas.
sentences.translation: Life has its joys and sorrows.

sentences.text: Nos mudamos a otro barrio.
sentences.translation: We moved to another neighborhood.

sentences.text: Es el mejor restaurante del barrio.
sentences.translation: It's the best restaurant in the neighborhood.

sentences.text: Los barrios del centro son caros.
sentences.translation: The neighborhoods in the center are expensive.

sentences.text: Mis abuelos tienen una granja.
sentences.translation: My grandparents have a farm.

sentences.text: Crecí en una granja.
sentences.translation: I grew up on a farm.

sentences.text: Las granjas de la zona venden huevos.
sentences.translation: The farms around here sell eggs.

sentences.text: Haz un esfuerzo, por favor.
sentences.translation: Make an effort, please.

sentences.text: Con un poco de esfuerzo, lo vas a conseguir.
sentences.translation: With a little effort, you'll manage it.

sentences.text: Todos sus esfuerzos fueron inútiles.
sentences.translation: All his efforts were in vain.

sentences.text: Encontraron un tesoro en la isla.
sentences.translation: They found treasure on the island.

sentences.text: El museo guarda tesoros muy antiguos.
sentences.translation: The museum keeps very old treasures.

sentences.text: ¿Qué te pasa, tesoro?
sentences.translation: What's wrong, darling?

sentences.text: En verano hay más empleo en la costa.
sentences.translation: In summer there's more work on the coast.

sentences.text: Perdió su empleo el mes pasado.
sentences.translation: He lost his job last month.

sentences.text: La fábrica trae muchos empleos al pueblo.
sentences.translation: The factory brings lots of jobs to the town.

sentences.text: Necesita cirugía urgente.
sentences.translation: He needs urgent surgery.

sentences.text: Es el jefe de cirugía del hospital.
sentences.translation: He's the head of surgery at the hospital.

sentences.text: Volvió al trabajo una semana después de la cirugía.
sentences.translation: She went back to work a week after the surgery.

notes: In Spain a single operation is usually una operación.
The key for a door is la llave.

sentences.text: La clave es practicar cada día.
sentences.translation: The key is to practice every day.

sentences.text: Olvidé la clave de mi tarjeta.
sentences.translation: I forgot the PIN for my card.

sentences.text: Tengo demasiadas claves y las olvido.
sentences.translation: I have too many passwords and I forget them.

sentences.text: Aparentemente, nadie lo vio.
sentences.translation: Apparently, nobody saw it.

sentences.text: Es un problema aparentemente simple.
sentences.translation: It's a seemingly simple problem.

sentences.text: Aparentemente está bien, pero no come.
sentences.translation: He seems fine, but he isn't eating.

sentences.text: No puedo controlar a mi perro.
sentences.translation: I can't control my dog.

sentences.text: Ella controla todo en la oficina.
sentences.translation: She controls everything in the office.

sentences.text: La policía controló los coches en la frontera.
sentences.translation: The police checked the cars at the border.

sentences.text: Lo tengo todo controlado.
sentences.translation: I've got everything under control.

notes: el piloto, la piloto.

sentences.text: Mi madre fue piloto durante veinte años.
sentences.translation: My mother was a pilot for twenty years.

sentences.text: En el avión hay dos pilotos.
sentences.translation: There are two pilots on the plane.

sentences.text: Quiere ser piloto de carreras.
sentences.translation: He wants to be a racing driver.

notes: un bolso = a handbag; una bolsa = a bag, such as a plastic bag.

sentences.text: ¿Has visto mi bolso?
sentences.translation: Have you seen my handbag?

sentences.text: Me robaron el bolso en el metro.
sentences.translation: Someone stole my handbag on the subway.

sentences.text: Esa tienda vende bolsos de piel.
sentences.translation: That shop sells leather handbags.

sentences.text: Respira despacio.
sentences.translation: Breathe slowly.

sentences.text: No puedo respirar.
sentences.translation: I can't breathe.

sentences.text: ¿Está respirando?
sentences.translation: Is he breathing?

sentences.text: Por fin respiré tranquila.
sentences.translation: At last I could breathe easy.

sentences.text: Tu nombre no aparece en la lista.
sentences.translation: Your name isn't on the list.

sentences.text: De repente apareció un hombre.
sentences.translation: Suddenly a man appeared.

sentences.text: Las llaves aparecieron en el coche.
sentences.translation: The keys turned up in the car.

sentences.text: Hicieron una campaña para salvar el parque.
sentences.translation: They ran a campaign to save the park.

sentences.text: Ayer terminó la campaña.
sentences.translation: The campaign ended yesterday.

sentences.text: Esas campañas de publicidad son muy caras.
sentences.translation: Those advertising campaigns are very expensive.

sentences.text: Nuestra amistad empezó en el colegio.
sentences.translation: Our friendship started at school.

sentences.text: Una buena amistad dura toda la vida.
sentences.translation: A good friendship lasts a lifetime.

sentences.text: Tiene malas amistades.
sentences.translation: He has bad friends.

notes: estar al corriente = to be up to date.

sentences.text: Hay corrientes peligrosas en esta playa.
sentences.translation: There are dangerous currents at this beach.

sentences.text: Cierra la ventana, que hay corriente.
sentences.translation: Close the window, there's a draft.

sentences.text: Me dio la corriente al tocar el cable.
sentences.translation: I got a shock when I touched the wire.

sentences.text: El perro está comiendo un hueso.
sentences.translation: The dog is eating a bone.

sentences.text: Se rompió un hueso de la mano.
sentences.translation: He broke a bone in his hand.

sentences.text: La leche es buena para los huesos.
sentences.translation: Milk is good for your bones.

sentences.text: Esta canción tiene buen ritmo.
sentences.translation: This song has a good beat.

sentences.text: No puedo seguir tu ritmo.
sentences.translation: I can't keep up with you.

sentences.text: Cada uno aprende a su ritmo.
sentences.translation: Everyone learns at their own pace.

notes: For a woman: la socia.

sentences.text: Mi socio y yo abrimos un restaurante.
sentences.translation: My business partner and I opened a restaurant.

sentences.text: Soy socio del club desde niño.
sentences.translation: I've been a member of the club since I was a boy.

sentences.text: Los socios pagan menos.
sentences.translation: Members pay less.

sentences.text: El motor no arranca.
sentences.translation: The engine won't start.

sentences.text: Apaga el motor, por favor.
sentences.translation: Turn off the engine, please.

sentences.text: El barco tiene dos motores.
sentences.translation: The boat has two engines.

notes: In Spain, mono as a describing word also means cute: ¡Qué mono!

sentences.text: Los monos viven en los árboles.
sentences.translation: Monkeys live in trees.

sentences.text: Ese mono es muy gracioso.
sentences.translation: That monkey is very funny.

sentences.text: Un mono me quitó la comida.
sentences.translation: A monkey took my food.

sentences.text: Abre el libro en la página diez.
sentences.translation: Open the book to page ten.

sentences.text: Me quedan veinte páginas.
sentences.translation: I have twenty pages left.

sentences.text: Busca la información en la página web.
sentences.translation: Look for the information on the website.

notes: The o changes to ue in ruego, ruega. Se ruega... is common on signs.

sentences.text: Te ruego que me ayudes.
sentences.translation: I'm begging you to help me.

sentences.text: Se ruega silencio.
sentences.translation: Please be quiet.

sentences.text: Le rogó que no se fuera.
sentences.translation: She begged him not to leave.

notes: estar aburrido = to be bored; ser aburrido = to be boring.

sentences.text: Estoy aburrido.
sentences.translation: I'm bored.

sentences.text: La película fue muy aburrida.
sentences.translation: The movie was really boring.

sentences.text: Los niños están aburridos en casa.
sentences.translation: The kids are bored at home.

sentences.text: Ha llegado un paquete para ti.
sentences.translation: A package has arrived for you.

sentences.text: Compra un paquete de arroz, por favor.
sentences.translation: Buy a pack of rice, please.

sentences.text: Esperamos dos paquetes esta semana.
sentences.translation: We're expecting two packages this week.

sentences.text: El soldado murió en combate.
sentences.translation: The soldier died in combat.

sentences.text: El combate fue muy duro.
sentences.translation: The fight was really tough.

sentences.text: Ha ganado todos sus combates.
sentences.translation: He has won all his fights.

sentences.text: Gracias, me ha sido muy útil.
sentences.translation: Thanks, that was really helpful.

sentences.text: Es útil saber un poco de inglés.
sentences.translation: It's useful to know a little English.

sentences.text: Te doy unos consejos útiles.
sentences.translation: I'll give you some useful tips.

sentences.text: Fuimos a ver un castillo muy antiguo.
sentences.translation: We went to see a very old castle.

sentences.text: Los niños hacen castillos de arena.
sentences.translation: The kids are building sandcastles.

sentences.text: El rey vivía en un castillo.
sentences.translation: The king lived in a castle.

notes: A ball for games is usually una pelota.

sentences.text: Hicimos una guerra de bolas de nieve.
sentences.translation: We had a snowball fight.

sentences.text: Hice una bola con el papel.
sentences.translation: I made a ball out of the paper.

sentences.text: Quiero dos bolas de helado.
sentences.translation: I want two scoops of ice cream.

notes: el asistente, la asistente.

sentences.text: Mi asistente te llamará mañana.
sentences.translation: My assistant will call you tomorrow.

sentences.text: Es la asistente del director.
sentences.translation: She's the director's assistant.

sentences.text: La doctora tiene dos asistentes.
sentences.translation: The doctor has two assistants.

notes: On doors in Spain, tirar = pull.

sentences.text: No tires papeles al suelo.
sentences.translation: Don't throw paper on the floor.

sentences.text: Tiró la pelota muy lejos.
sentences.translation: He threw the ball really far.

sentences.text: ¿Has tirado la basura?
sentences.translation: Have you thrown out the trash?

sentences.text: Necesito a alguien honesto para este trabajo.
sentences.translation: I need someone honest for this job.

sentences.text: Mi abuela era una mujer honesta y trabajadora.
sentences.translation: My grandmother was an honest, hard-working woman.

sentences.text: Mis padres siempre fueron honestos conmigo.
sentences.translation: My parents were always honest with me.

notes: In Latin America carro = car; in Spain people say coche.

sentences.text: Coge un carro, que vamos a comprar mucho.
sentences.translation: Grab a cart, we're going to buy a lot.

sentences.text: Hay que devolver los carros a su sitio.
sentences.translation: You have to put the carts back.

sentences.text: Vamos en mi carro.
sentences.translation: Let's go in my car.

sentences.text: La casa está en venta.
sentences.translation: The house is for sale.

sentences.text: Las ventas han bajado este año.
sentences.translation: Sales have gone down this year.

sentences.text: Hizo su primera venta ayer.
sentences.translation: She made her first sale yesterday.

notes: A y appears in many forms: huyo, huye, huyó.

sentences.text: No puedes huir de tus problemas.
sentences.translation: You can't run away from your problems.

sentences.text: Muchas familias huyen de la guerra.
sentences.translation: Many families are fleeing the war.

sentences.text: El ladrón huyó por la ventana.
sentences.translation: The thief escaped through the window.

sentences.text: Tener un perro es un compromiso.
sentences.translation: Having a dog is a commitment.

sentences.text: Esta semana tengo muchos compromisos.
sentences.translation: I have a lot of commitments this week.

sentences.text: Me enseñó su anillo de compromiso.
sentences.translation: She showed me her engagement ring.

gloss: to make sure; to assure; to insure
notes: asegurarse de = to make sure.

sentences.text: Te aseguro que es verdad.
sentences.translation: I assure you it's true.

sentences.text: Asegúrate de que todos tengan agua.
sentences.translation: Make sure everyone has water.

sentences.text: Quiero asegurarme de que estás bien.
sentences.translation: I want to make sure you're okay.

sentences.text: El coche está asegurado.
sentences.translation: The car is insured.

sentences.text: No pudo controlar su ira.
sentences.translation: He couldn't control his anger.

sentences.text: Tenía los ojos llenos de ira.
sentences.translation: His eyes were full of rage.

sentences.text: La ira no arregla nada.
sentences.translation: Anger doesn't fix anything.

notes: cumplir una promesa = to keep a promise.

sentences.text: Cumplió su promesa.
sentences.translation: He kept his promise.

sentences.text: No hagas promesas que no puedas cumplir.
sentences.translation: Don't make promises you can't keep.

sentences.text: Rompiste tu promesa.
sentences.translation: You broke your promise.

sentences.text: No tiene importancia.
sentences.translation: It's not important.

sentences.text: Mis padres dan mucha importancia a los estudios.
sentences.translation: My parents think school is very important.

sentences.text: Es un tema de gran importancia.
sentences.translation: It's a matter of great importance.

sentences.text: Hoy empezamos la lección cinco.
sentences.translation: Today we're starting lesson five.

sentences.text: Espero que hayas aprendido la lección.
sentences.translation: I hope you've learned your lesson.

sentences.text: Faltan dos lecciones para el examen.
sentences.translation: There are two lessons left before the exam.

sentences.text: Personalmente, no me gusta nada.
sentences.translation: Personally, I don't like it at all.

sentences.text: Quiero darle las gracias personalmente.
sentences.translation: I want to thank her in person.

sentences.text: No lo conozco personalmente.
sentences.translation: I don't know him personally.

sentences.text: Tengo las llaves en el bolsillo.
sentences.translation: I have the keys in my pocket.

sentences.text: Saca las manos de los bolsillos.
sentences.translation: Take your hands out of your pockets.

sentences.text: Pagué la cena de mi bolsillo.
sentences.translation: I paid for dinner out of my own pocket.

notes: materia prima = raw material. At school in Spain, asignatura is also common.

sentences.text: Este año tengo ocho materias.
sentences.translation: I have eight subjects this year.

sentences.text: El inglés es la materia que mejor se me da.
sentences.translation: English is the subject I'm best at.

sentences.text: Sabe mucho de la materia.
sentences.translation: He knows a lot about the subject.

sentences.text: La fábrica necesita más materia prima.
sentences.translation: The factory needs more raw material.

notes: por desgracia = unfortunately.

sentences.text: Por desgracia, no pude ir.
sentences.translation: Unfortunately, I couldn't go.

sentences.text: Fue una desgracia para toda la familia.
sentences.translation: It was a tragedy for the whole family.

sentences.text: Las desgracias nunca vienen solas.
sentences.translation: Bad things never come alone.

sentences.text: Leí un artículo muy interesante.
sentences.translation: I read a very interesting article.

sentences.text: Escribe artículos para un periódico.
sentences.translation: She writes articles for a newspaper.

sentences.text: Este artículo está de oferta.
sentences.translation: This item is on sale.

sentences.text: Se puso crema en los labios.
sentences.translation: She put some cream on her lips.

sentences.text: Tiene sangre en el labio.
sentences.translation: He has blood on his lip.

sentences.text: Me dio un beso en los labios.
sentences.translation: She kissed me on the lips.

notes: hacer cola = to wait in line.

sentences.text: Hay mucha cola en el banco.
sentences.translation: There's a long line at the bank.

sentences.text: Odio las colas.
sentences.translation: I hate waiting in line.

sentences.text: El perro mueve la cola.
sentences.translation: The dog is wagging its tail.

sentences.text: ¿Quieres una taza de té?
sentences.translation: Would you like a cup of tea?

sentences.text: Se me cayó la taza.
sentences.translation: I dropped the cup.

sentences.text: Pon dos tazas en la mesa.
sentences.translation: Put two cups on the table.

sentences.text: Los niños juegan con la pelota.
sentences.translation: The kids are playing with the ball.

sentences.text: La pelota se fue a la calle.
sentences.translation: The ball went into the street.

sentences.text: Tenemos tres pelotas de tenis.
sentences.translation: We have three tennis balls.

sentences.text: Ponte la chaqueta, hace frío.
sentences.translation: Put your jacket on, it's cold.

sentences.text: Me he dejado la chaqueta en el bar.
sentences.translation: I've left my jacket at the bar.

sentences.text: ¿Cuál de las dos chaquetas te gusta más?
sentences.translation: Which of the two jackets do you like better?

sentences.text: ¿Estás interesado en el trabajo?
sentences.translation: Are you interested in the job?

sentences.text: Ella no parece interesada.
sentences.translation: She doesn't seem interested.

sentences.text: Varias personas están interesadas en comprar la casa.
sentences.translation: Several people are interested in buying the house.

sentences.text: El gato atrapa ratones.
sentences.translation: The cat catches mice.

sentences.text: La policía atrapó al ladrón.
sentences.translation: The police caught the thief.

sentences.text: Nos quedamos atrapados en el ascensor.
sentences.translation: We got stuck in the elevator.

sentences.text: Es obvio que no le gustas.
sentences.translation: It's obvious he doesn't like you.

sentences.text: La solución era obvia.
sentences.translation: The solution was obvious.

sentences.text: No digas cosas tan obvias.
sentences.translation: Don't say such obvious things.

sentences.text: Tengo entrenamiento a las seis.
sentences.translation: I have practice at six.

sentences.text: Después del entrenamiento siempre tengo hambre.
sentences.translation: After training I'm always hungry.

sentences.text: Los entrenamientos son los martes y jueves.
sentences.translation: Practice is on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

notes: A live fish is un pez.

sentences.text: ¿Tú comes pescado?
sentences.translation: Do you eat fish?

sentences.text: Prefiero el pescado a la carne.
sentences.translation: I prefer fish to meat.

sentences.text: En este mercado venden pescado fresco.
sentences.translation: They sell fresh fish at this market.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde dejo el abrigo?
sentences.translation: Where should I leave my coat?

sentences.text: Este abrigo me queda grande.
sentences.translation: This coat is too big for me.

sentences.text: Saca los abrigos del armario.
sentences.translation: Take the coats out of the wardrobe.

sentences.text: ¿Qué estudias?
sentences.translation: What are you studying?

sentences.text: Estudié medicina en Madrid.
sentences.translation: I studied medicine in Madrid.

sentences.text: Mi hijo está estudiando para un examen.
sentences.translation: My son is studying for an exam.

sentences.text: Tiene una sonrisa preciosa.
sentences.translation: She has a lovely smile.

sentences.text: Lo dijo con una sonrisa.
sentences.translation: He said it with a smile.

sentences.text: Había sonrisas en todas las caras.
sentences.translation: There were smiles on every face.

notes: el cobarde, la cobarde. Also a describing word: No seas cobarde.

sentences.text: Eres un cobarde.
sentences.translation: You're a coward.

sentences.text: Fue una cobarde y no dijo nada.
sentences.translation: She was a coward and didn't say anything.

sentences.text: Solo los cobardes atacan a los débiles.
sentences.translation: Only cowards attack the weak.

notes: In Spain the school itself is usually called el instituto.

sentences.text: Mi hija está en secundaria.
sentences.translation: My daughter is in secondary school.

sentences.text: Nos conocemos desde secundaria.
sentences.translation: We've known each other since secondary school.

sentences.text: Es profesor de secundaria.
sentences.translation: He's a secondary school teacher.

sentences.text: ¿Tienes tiempo para una charla?
sentences.translation: Do you have time for a chat?

sentences.text: Mañana doy una charla en la universidad.
sentences.translation: Tomorrow I'm giving a talk at the university.

sentences.text: Me encantan nuestras charlas.
sentences.translation: I love our chats.

sentences.text: La bruja vivía en el bosque.
sentences.translation: The witch lived in the forest.

sentences.text: Mi abuela dice que la vecina es una bruja.
sentences.translation: My grandmother says the neighbor is a witch.

sentences.text: No creo en brujas.
sentences.translation: I don't believe in witches.

notes: la oreja is the outside part; hearing and the inner ear are el oído.

sentences.text: El perro tiene las orejas muy largas.
sentences.translation: The dog has very long ears.

sentences.text: Lleva un pendiente en la oreja.
sentences.translation: He wears an earring in his ear.

sentences.text: Hablaba con el teléfono en la oreja.
sentences.translation: She was talking with the phone to her ear.

sentences.text: Llevo veinte años en esta empresa.
sentences.translation: I've been at this company for twenty years.

sentences.text: Somos veinte en la clase.
sentences.translation: There are twenty of us in the class.

sentences.text: Me debes veinte euros.
sentences.translation: You owe me twenty euros.

gloss: to take care of (encargarse de); to order (in advance)
notes: encargarse de algo = to take care of something, to be in charge of it.

sentences.text: Yo me encargo de la cena.
sentences.translation: I'll take care of dinner.

sentences.text: ¿Quién se encarga de los niños?
sentences.translation: Who's looking after the kids?

sentences.text: Encargué una tarta para su cumpleaños.
sentences.translation: I ordered a cake for her birthday.

sentences.text: Hoy el palacio está cerrado.
sentences.translation: The palace is closed today.

sentences.text: Su casa parece un palacio.
sentences.translation: Her house looks like a palace.

sentences.text: En Madrid hay muchos palacios.
sentences.translation: There are lots of palaces in Madrid.

sentences.text: Mantén la mano firme.
sentences.translation: Keep your hand steady.

sentences.text: Fue muy firme con los niños.
sentences.translation: She was very firm with the kids.

sentences.text: Camina con pasos firmes.
sentences.translation: He walks with steady steps.

sentences.text: No me sorprende nada.
sentences.translation: I'm not surprised at all.

sentences.text: Su respuesta me sorprendió.
sentences.translation: Her answer surprised me.

sentences.text: Queremos sorprender a mamá.
sentences.translation: We want to surprise Mom.

sentences.text: Estoy muy sorprendida.
sentences.translation: I'm very surprised.

sentences.text: Es un milagro que estés vivo.
sentences.translation: It's a miracle you're alive.

sentences.text: No hago milagros.
sentences.translation: I can't work miracles.

sentences.text: Llegamos a tiempo de milagro.
sentences.translation: We got there on time by some miracle.

sentences.text: No soporto el ruido de la calle.
sentences.translation: I can't stand the noise from the street.

sentences.text: Mi hermana no soporta a su jefe.
sentences.translation: My sister can't stand her boss.

sentences.text: ¿Cómo soportaste tanto dolor?
sentences.translation: How did you bear so much pain?

notes: estar de moda = to be in fashion.

sentences.text: Ese color está de moda.
sentences.translation: That color is in fashion.

sentences.text: Trabaja en el mundo de la moda.
sentences.translation: She works in fashion.

sentences.text: Las modas cambian muy rápido.
sentences.translation: Fashions change very quickly.

notes: A despacho is one person's room; the whole workplace is la oficina.

sentences.text: El jefe está en su despacho.
sentences.translation: The boss is in his office.

sentences.text: Tengo un despacho en casa.
sentences.translation: I have a study at home.

sentences.text: Los despachos de este edificio son pequeños.
sentences.translation: The offices in this building are small.

notes: For a woman: la vecina.

sentences.text: Mi vecino tiene un perro enorme.
sentences.translation: My neighbor has a huge dog.

sentences.text: Conozco a todos mis vecinos.
sentences.translation: I know all my neighbors.

sentences.text: La vecina del quinto me ayudó.
sentences.translation: The neighbor on the fifth floor helped me.

notes: A wine glass is una copa.

sentences.text: Se me ha roto un vaso.
sentences.translation: I've broken a glass.

sentences.text: Bebe un vaso de leche cada mañana.
sentences.translation: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.

sentences.text: Saca los vasos limpios.
sentences.translation: Get out the clean glasses.

sentences.text: Oímos una explosión.
sentences.translation: We heard an explosion.

sentences.text: La explosión rompió todas las ventanas.
sentences.translation: The explosion broke all the windows.

sentences.text: Hubo dos explosiones en la fábrica.
sentences.translation: There were two explosions at the factory.

notes: Also the verb poder = can, to be able to.

sentences.text: El dinero da poder.
sentences.translation: Money gives you power.

sentences.text: Tiene mucho poder en la empresa.
sentences.translation: She has a lot of power in the company.

sentences.text: En la película, la niña tiene poderes.
sentences.translation: In the movie, the girl has powers.

sentences.text: Hazme una copia de la llave.
sentences.translation: Make me a copy of the key.

sentences.text: Necesito dos copias del contrato.
sentences.translation: I need two copies of the contract.

sentences.text: Esto es una copia, no el original.
sentences.translation: This is a copy, not the original.

sentences.text: Viajo mucho por trabajo.
sentences.translation: I travel a lot for work.

sentences.text: El año pasado viajamos a Italia.
sentences.translation: Last year we traveled to Italy.

sentences.text: ¿Has viajado alguna vez sola?
sentences.translation: Have you ever traveled alone?

sentences.text: Me encanta viajar en tren.
sentences.translation: I love traveling by train.

sentences.text: Lleva una cadena de oro.
sentences.translation: She wears a gold chain.

sentences.text: La bici tiene la cadena rota.
sentences.translation: The bike's chain is broken.

sentences.text: ¿En qué cadena ponen el partido?
sentences.translation: What channel is the game on?

sentences.text: Hay demasiadas cadenas de televisión.
sentences.translation: There are too many TV channels.

sentences.text: Mi padre trabaja en una fábrica.
sentences.translation: My father works in a factory.

sentences.text: La fábrica cerró el año pasado.
sentences.translation: The factory closed last year.

sentences.text: Antes había fábricas en todo el barrio.
sentences.translation: There used to be factories all over the neighborhood.

notes: In Spain, educación often means good manners.

sentences.text: La educación pública es gratis en España.
sentences.translation: Public education is free in Spain.

sentences.text: Hablar con la boca llena es de mala educación.
sentences.translation: Talking with your mouth full is bad manners.

sentences.text: Pide las cosas con educación.
sentences.translation: Ask for things politely.
